issues.description: The problem statement declares the build_msd_circ parameter type for y_states as tuple[int], but the provided template and the solution both use list[int] for that parameter. This mismatch between the specification and the code-level type annotation can confuse students about the expected input type and lead to minor type-related inconsistencies in implementations and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type for y_states consistent across all artifacts. Either update the problem statement to declare y_states as list[int] (preferred for flexibility), or change the template and solution signatures to use tuple[int]. Also update any explanatory text to use the chosen container type consistently.
